headline: Execution Reset Delays Growth Visibility

highlights: Daily Volume 7,14,380 Revenue growth offset by higher operating expenses, impacting profitability ▪ Revenue grew by 23.9% YoY and 4.8% QoQ to INR 2,351 Mn (vs.
CIE estimate of INR 2,230 Mn) ▪ EBITDA de-grew by 21.8% YoY and 21.8% QoQ to INR 720 Mn (vs.
CIE estimate of INR 900 Mn); margin contracted by 1,786 bps YoY and 1,041 bps QoQ to 30.6% (vs.
CIE estimate of 40.4%), miss was attributed to higher marketing expenses. ▪ PAT decreased by 37.7% YoY and 44.4% QoQ to INR 366 Mn (vs.
valuation: Multiple growth levers; Ayushman Bharat inclusion remains a key optionality: While near-term execution remains the key monitorable, JSLL continues to develop newer growth avenues through newer revenue streams such as premium wellness, specialty care programmes and deeper insurance penetration.

While we do not factor any contribution from this into our base-case estimate, given the uncertainty around its implementation, any inclusion could materially improve occupancy, accelerate capacity utilisation and provide meaningful upside to our estimate.
View and valuation: We expect JSLL to deliver Revenue/EBITDA/PAT CAGR of 20.4%/11.9%/13.3% over FY26–29E.
watch: Multiple growth levers; Ayushman Bharat inclusion remains a key optionality: While near-term execution remains the key monitorable, JSLL continues to develop newer growth avenues through newer revenue streams such as premium wellness, specialty care programmes and deeper insurance penetration.

The management has also reduced its FY27 guidance to ~INR 10 Bn revenue (from ~INR 11 Bn earlier) and 35–40% EBITDA margin (from 40%+ previously), following delays in key growth initiatives and slower-than-expected execution.
